_meta.description: Curated end-to-end data engineering projects, grouped by the stack they're built on. Each project links to whatever exists for it — a repo, a video walkthrough, a written guide — because different people learn from different formats.

levels.beginner: One or two tools. You can finish it in a weekend and understand every part.
levels.intermediate: A real pipeline: several services, orchestration, a scheduled run.
levels.advanced: Streaming, infrastructure-as-code, or a full platform with governance.

_meta.note: Sources were found via web search and verified live by scripts/check-links.mjs. Levels and summaries are editorial judgements from each project's own description, not claims about how long it will take you.

domains.name: Streaming & real-time
domains.blurb: Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming and the operational reality of unbounded data.

domains.name: AWS
domains.blurb: Glue, Redshift, S3, Lambda, Kinesis and Athena wired into working pipelines.

domains.name: Azure
domains.blurb: Data Factory, Databricks, ADLS Gen2 and Synapse — usually with the medallion layering.

domains.name: Google Cloud
domains.blurb: BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub and Cloud Functions.

domains.name: Databricks & lakehouse
domains.blurb: Delta Lake, the medallion architecture and Unity Catalog.

domains.name: Warehousing & analytics engineering
domains.blurb: Snowflake and dbt — modelling, testing and deploying transformations.

domains.name: Orchestration
domains.blurb: Airflow DAGs against real APIs, scheduled and retried.

domains.name: Project collections
domains.blurb: Curated lists worth mining when you want more than the projects above.

projects.title: Real-time streaming pipeline: Kafka to Cassandra
projects.summary: Stream data from an API into Kafka, process it with Spark, land it in Cassandra and Postgres, and orchestrate the whole thing with Airflow — all in Docker.

projects.title: AWS streaming pipeline with Kinesis and Redshift
projects.summary: An end-to-end AWS pipeline spanning Glue, Lambda, Kinesis, Redshift, Athena and QuickSight — the closest thing here to a production AWS analytics stack.

projects.title: YouTube trending data analytics on AWS
projects.summary: Land raw YouTube trending data in S3, clean and partition it with Glue (PySpark), query it with Athena and build a QuickSight dashboard. The most-followed beginner AWS project.

projects.title: Bronze–silver–gold pipeline on AWS
projects.summary: Medallion layering applied to AWS: S3 and Kinesis for ingestion, Glue and Databricks for transformation, Redshift for serving.

projects.title: Orchestrated ETL with MWAA, Glue and Redshift Serverless
projects.summary: AWS's own reference build: S3 to Glue to Redshift Serverless, orchestrated by Managed Airflow. Useful because it shows the patterns AWS itself recommends.

projects.title: AdventureWorks pipeline on Azure
projects.summary: The canonical Azure build: Data Factory ingests, Databricks transforms, Synapse serves, Power BI reports. Uses the AdventureWorks sample database.

projects.title: Real-time Azure pipeline with ADF and Synapse
projects.summary: ADF and Synapse pipelines with Spark transformations and a Power BI layer on top — a fuller Azure workflow than the AdventureWorks build.

projects.title: On-premises SQL Server to Azure Data Lake
projects.summary: A migration-shaped project: pull from on-prem SQL Server into ADLS Gen2 via Data Factory, layer the processing in Databricks, serve through Synapse — with Key Vault and Entra ID for the security story.

projects.title: Streaming pipeline on GCP: Pub/Sub to BigQuery
projects.summary: Poll an air-quality API with Cloud Functions, publish to Pub/Sub, process in Dataflow, land in BigQuery and model with dbt. A genuinely complete GCP streaming build.

projects.title: dbt on BigQuery, deployed with Cloud Run
projects.summary: An analytics-engineering angle on GCP — dbt models against BigQuery, containerised and scheduled on Cloud Run rather than a managed orchestrator.

projects.title: Medallion lakehouse on Databricks
projects.summary: Bronze, silver and gold layers built with PySpark and Delta Lake over S3, organised as one notebook per layer. A clean reference for how medallion is actually laid out.

projects.title: Databricks lakehouse bootcamp
projects.summary: A full lakehouse implementation with datasets, notebooks, SQL and exercises — covering ingestion through to analytics-ready products, including Unity Catalog.

projects.title: Medallion lakehouse with ADF and dbt
projects.summary: A medallion lakehouse fed from a SQL database through Data Factory into Delta on ADLS Gen2, with dbt handling the transformations.

projects.title: Snowflake ELT with dbt and Airflow
projects.summary: An ELT pipeline over Snowflake's TPCH sample data — dbt for the modelling, Airflow for scheduling. Good because the dataset ships with Snowflake, so there's nothing to source.

projects.title: dbt on Snowflake — official getting started
projects.summary: Snowflake's own dbt project, covering environment setup, modelling, CI/CD and scheduling natively inside Snowflake. The authoritative starting point rather than a community build.

projects.title: Airflow ETL against a live API
projects.summary: A small, self-contained Airflow project: extract from an API, transform, load. The right first project if you've never written a DAG that runs on a schedule.

projects.title: Open-source data engineering projects
projects.summary: A continuously updated index of open-source data engineering projects — worth mining when you want something less commonly built than the ones above.

projects.title: 40+ data engineering projects with source code
projects.summary: A large catalogue spanning beginner to advanced, useful for finding a project in a domain the ones above don't cover.
